# Vendored model codec

The offline art tools use `mu.py`, the standalone KSP model codec from Bill Currie's `io_object_mu` Blender add-on. This copy is from revision `ff04234928b2e66f92d2d1325225e9a29f0b415c`. [Upstream source file](https://github.com/taniwha/io_object_mu/blob/ff04234928b2e66f92d2d1325225e9a29f0b415c/mu.py)
